findingDetails.title: Parent coordination map is stale against every child phase status
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct status sweep over 001 through 012 child spec.md files found all twelve Complete rows, while the parent map keeps all twelve rows Planned.

claimAdjudication.claim: The parent coordination map lists all twelve child phases as Planned even though the child specs self-report Complete and the parent calls that map the coordination truth.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Reread the full parent phase map and ran a filename-bearing status sweep across all child spec.md files. No child spec status row reported Planned.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The parent table may have been intended as a planning snapshot, but the same section labels it the coordination truth and it has no separate planning-vs-execution status column.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: If the parent explicitly labels the table as a historical planning snapshot and adds a current execution-status source elsewhere, downgrade to P2 documentation hygiene.

findingDetails.title: Command-metadata phase claims Complete while live-generation acceptance remains unmet
findingDetails.scopeProof: Checked the phase spec, the phase implementation summary, and both named live bridge consumers projection.ts and skill_advisor.py.

claimAdjudication.claim: Phase 011 is marked Complete even though its generated-live-bridge acceptance criteria are not met and its own summary records the cutover as reverted or planned.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Searched for command bridge generation markers and CLI flags, then reread both live bridge definitions. Shadow tooling exists, but the live TS/Python bridge definitions remain non-generated and the phase text explicitly says the live cutover was reverted.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The team may intend Complete to mean shadow machinery complete, but the spec's success criteria still require live generated blocks and the implementation summary has not reconciled the deferred requirement.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: If the phase spec is amended to define shadow-only completion and explicitly defer generated live bridge acceptance to a new owning phase, downgrade to P2 or resolved depending on parent mapping.

findingDetails.title: Workflow leaves token permissions implicit while npm-fetched tools execute
findingDetails.scopeProof: Searched for explicit permissions blocks across the workflow and related target; none exist in routing-registry-drift.yml, while both jobs run dependency-backed commands.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If repository/org defaults are proven to force read-only GITHUB_TOKEN permissions for this workflow, treat this as resolved hardening rather than an active advisory.

noveltyJustification: Weighted new findings 1 over accumulated active weighted total 12: prior active weight 11 plus one new P2 weight 1.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Phase-parent target plus CI, Python, and TypeScript implementation anchors named by the review scope.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Security focus prioritized workflow token authority, subprocess execution, generated metadata write boundaries, and actual checked-in scaffold script integration context.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Workflow may run dependency-backed commands without constraining GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.

searchActions.result: Trigger block is followed by jobs with no explicit permissions block before checkout and npx execution.

Other workflows have permission blocks; routing-registry-drift.yml does not.

searchLedger.rationale: Security hardening is warranted because CI dependency execution does not declare the least-privilege token floor.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Reviewed Python scripts may interpolate untrusted values into shell commands.

searchActions.result: Subprocess invocation uses list-form arguments, JSON stdin, fixed cwd, timeout, and explicit env.
Subprocess invocation uses list-form arguments with fixed runner path and dataset as an argv element, not shell interpolation.

searchLedger.rationale: No shell-based command construction was evidenced in the reviewed subprocess sites.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: List-form subprocess calls avoid shell interpretation for the reviewed inputs.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Derived metadata sync may write graph metadata outside the workspace root.

searchActions.result: skillDir is resolved and rejected unless it stays within workspaceRoot before graphMetadataPath is joined and written.

searchLedger.rationale: The reviewed writer enforces workspace containment before choosing the write path.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Resolved skillDir outside workspaceRoot throws before write.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Generated derived metadata may persist instruction-shaped strings across trust boundaries.

searchActions.result: Sanitizer rejects long, empty, instruction-shaped, markup-shaped, or label-sanitization-empty values before returning boundary metadata.

searchLedger.rationale: The reviewed sanitizer rejects the obvious prompt-injection-shaped derived strings before storage.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Instruction and markup shaped values are filtered before returning a sanitized value.
